test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Choose the correctly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct spelling is '**Descendant**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the correctly spelt word is '**Descendant**'.
 
• It means **'a person who belongs to the same family as somebody who lived a long time ago; a person, plant, or animal that is descended from a particular ancestor'.**** **(वंशज, संतति)
 
 
• *Example: Her family are **descendants** of one of the first Englishmen to arrive in India.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Descendant.*
